sentences.text: Psephochelys was an extinct placodont reptile that lived in China during the Late Triassic. It possessed a wide shell covering its body, resembling that of a modern turtle.
Unlike other cyamodontoids, the shell of Psephochelys covered only its back.
The genus was named in 2002 based on a single partial skeleton discovered in the Carnian-age Falong Formation in Guizhou Province.
Psephochelys belongs to the family Placochelyidae and the superfamily Cyamodontoidea.
Psephochelys lived between 233.6 and 227.3 million years ago during the Carnian age.
